name: musaddiqr-motion
description: Two motion pieces (projects ~29.5s, agents ~28s) for musaddiqr.com, rendered with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render projects out/projects.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 --muted && remotion render agents3d out/agents.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 --muted --gl=angle && remotion still projects out/projects-poster.jpg --frame=179 && remotion still agents3d out/agents-poster.jpg --frame=584
